title: Easy and Delicious School Lunchbox Ideas for Teens That They’ll Actually Eat
promptIMG: Food photography: school lunchbox ideas for teens, appetizing presentation with colorful compartments filled with sandwiches, fresh fruits, veggies, and snacks, natural lighting, kitchen setting, documentary style, realistic colors --ar 4:3 --quality 2

image_prompts.img1: SCENE: a softly blurred home kitchen with warm natural daylight streaming through a window, faint reflections on a clean countertop. SUBJECT: a vibrant lunchbox opened flat, filled to the brim with a variety of teen-friendly lunch items including a neatly cut turkey sandwich with crisp lettuce and tomato, bright orange carrot sticks, juicy red apple slices, and a small container of mixed nuts. The sandwich front piece is sharply focused at a 30-degree angle showing its soft bread texture and fresh fillings, the rest of the lunch items recede gently into soft bokeh. DETAILS: fresh, natural colors with a slight glossy shine on the apple slices and sandwich veggies, crumbs and natural irregularities on the sandwich bread edges. STYLE: ultra-photorealistic professional food photography, bright airy daylight with warm golden tones, rich saturated colors giving a fresh and inviting look, shallow macro depth of field, vertical 2:3. AVOID: no text, no hands, no people, no flat or dull colors, no CGI or plastic textures, no steam or smoke.
image_prompts.img2: SCENE: soft blurred background of a marble-toned countertop with bright clean daylight from a nearby window. SUBJECT: a close-up reveal shot of the turkey sandwich cut in half and stacked, showing the juicy layers of turkey, melted cheddar cheese, crisp lettuce, and ripe tomato. The sandwich halves fill 90% of the frame with the moist interior glistening and the bread crust golden and slightly toasted. DETAILS: the sandwich interior shines with fresh moisture contrast against the toasted bread edges, a few crumbs scattered naturally below the sandwich. STYLE: ultra-photorealistic professional food photography, bright airy daylight with warm golden-amber tones, rich saturated colors highlighting freshness and texture, shallow macro depth of field, vertical 2:3. AVOID: no text, no hands, no people, no dull or pale colors, no CGI or over-smoothing.
image_prompts.img3: SCENE: warm dark wood table softly blurred with a gentle side glow creating a cozy atmosphere. SUBJECT: several lunchbox items arranged together including the turkey sandwich halves topped with a small sprig of fresh parsley, a small bowl of mixed berries, crunchy carrot sticks, and a container of hummus dip. The front sandwich half is razor-sharp with a glossy finish on the veggies and cheese, the other items softly recede into warm bokeh. DETAILS: intense wet glossy shine on fruit and sandwich fillings, deep amber toasted edges on bread, a light sprinkle of sea salt on carrot sticks, natural crumbs scattered around. STYLE: ultra-photorealistic professional food photography, deep golden-amber warm color grade, rich saturated glowing appetizing tones, shallow macro depth of field, vertical 2:3. AVOID: no text, no hands, no people, no washed-out colors, no plastic textures, no steam or smoke.
